title: Balloon Flight
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Balloon Flight.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Shamae]] |location= Woodland Stable |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Star Fragment }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Balloon Flight||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Balloon Flight}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Woodland Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At [[Woodland Stable]], [[Link]] can encounter [[Shamae]] talking about [[Balloon]]s to herself.{{Cite|Balloons. Floaty balloons.|Shamae|BotW}} Upon speaking to her, she shares her belief people used to live in the sky, which she sometimes sees in her dreams.{{Cite|I sometimes see it in my dreams. Do you think that a long time ago people used to live in the sky? I think so...|Shamae|BotW}} Shamae tells Link that she would like to see Balloons floating in the sky, promising a treasure from the sky if he helps her.{{Cite|Hey, mister! Just once in my life, I want to see {{Color BotW|Red|balloons}} float right up into the sky! If you'll help me realize my {{Color BotW|Red|balloon}} dream, I'll give you a treasure I got from the sky as thanks!|Shamae|BotW}} When Link agrees, Shamae tells him to put Balloons on a [[Barrel]] to make it float.{{Cite|[Leave it to me.] Thank you! Now put some {{Color BotW|Red|balloons}} onto a barrel and make it float up high!|Shamae|BotW}} Link can bring Shamae [[Octo Balloon]]s, at which point she tells him to tie some to the barrel next to her.{{Cite|Yaaaaay! You brought me {{Color BotW|Red|balloons}}! What a guy! You should tie those {{Color BotW|Red|balloons}} on to that barrel and make it soar into the sky!|Shamae|BotW}} At least two Octo Balloons are needed in order for the Barrel to start floating. Once this is done, Shamae becomes overjoyed.{{Cite|Floaty! {{Color BotW|Red|Balloons}} soaring high in the sky! Fly up and away to the land in the clouds!|Shamae|BotW}} Shamae tells Link that her dream is to float up to the land in the sky with a balloon, and then to ride a big bird.{{Cite|I want to visit the land in the sky by {{Color BotW|Red|balloon}}. Then, I'm going to ride a really big bird. Yep, that's my dream!|Shamae|BotW}} Afterwards, she rewards Link with a [[Star Fragment]].{{Cite|Thank you, mister! This is a {{Color BotW|Red|treasure}} from the sky! Here, take it!|Shamae|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You promised Shamae, the kid from the Woodland Stable, that you'd show her a sky filled with {{Color BotW|Red|balloons}}.

The first step is to find things that serve as {{Color BotW|Red|balloons}}, and then use them to life the barrels to delight Shamae. |- | Complete | With the ingenious use of {{Color BotW|Red|Octo balloons}}, you kept your promise to Shamae.

As thanks, she gave you a star fragment. }} ==Trivia== * This Side Quest references {{SS}} on several occasions. ** Shamae tells Link of her dream that people used to live in the sky, referring to [[Skyloft]]. ** Shamae wants to ride a big bird in the sky, alluding to [[Loftwing]]s. ** The reward, a Star Fragment, resembles the [[Gratitude Crystal]]s received after completing Quests in Skyloft. * Unlike many other Side Quests, there is no alternate dialogue if you complete this Side Quest with 999 [[Star Fragment]]s. Doing so merely causes the one offered as a reward to disappear after being given out. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Shamae * Woodland Stable }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
